about: The doodles in the tray's Doodles tab. Yours to edit: redraw one, paste in your own, or delete any. Each is a little SVG drawing: svg is the inside of an <svg> (shapes and paths; no scripts, pictures or links). w and h are its size (default 60 by 60), so svg should draw inside a box that big. line: true wraps the drawing in the standard hand-inked line (dark brown, round ends), so inside it you only write shapes and fills; leave line out to style everything yourself. A fill can be offset a couple of pixels from its outline for the hand-colored look. Write {c0} to {c4} in any color to use that day's five palette colors. Use single quotes inside svg. If two doodles use gradients, give each gradient its own id. id is lowercase letters, digits and dashes, and a postcard remembers it, so avoid renaming one you have already used. The order here is the order in the tray.
